Texts.Home:HeroSubtitle: Smart pantry management and food tracking
Texts.Home:HeroDescription: Consult packaged food information, keep your pantry organized, and receive expiration warnings to avoid food waste.
Texts.Home:GuestBannerDescription: Sign in or create an account to store items in your personal pantry, set preferences, and receive expiration alerts.
Texts.Home:ActiveSessionBadge: Active session — Explore your personal modules below
Texts.Home:QuickAccessSubtitle: Navigate to the different SmartPantry tools
Texts.Home:SearchDescription: Check public information on packaged food products and barcodes.
Texts.Home:PantryDescription: Manage your stock, quantities, and monitor expiration dates.
Texts.Home:PreferencesDescription: Configure dietary restrictions, unwanted ingredients, or allergens.
Texts.Home:AlertsDescription: Check products close to expiring and automatic consumption notices.
Texts.Home:GuestProtectedDescription: The My Pantry, Preferences, and Alerts modules require authentication to protect your personal data.
